scope: Planning-only audit of the 215 genuinely missing related-dream destinations in the current 335-dream dataset.
methodology: Qualitative editorial prioritization—not measured Google search volume—using relationship frequency, topic breadth, context-first interpretation depth, overlap with all canonical dreams, cannibalization risk, and sourcing/sensitivity requirements.

topNewOpportunities.title: Swimming
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Covers active movement through water—effort, direction, depth, current, confidence, and getting ashore—rather than the existing dirty-water scenario.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Calm, struggling, racing, underwater, open-water, pool, rescue, and destination-led scenarios.

topNewOpportunities.title: Elevator
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Vertical movement, floor selection, doors, controls, speed, and mechanical failure create a distinct transition-and-control framework beyond generic confinement.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Rising, falling, stuck, crowded, wrong-floor, broken-control, and open-shaft contexts.

topNewOpportunities.title: Seeing Your Younger Self
topNewOpportunities.distinct: A direct encounter with a former self centers identity continuity, memory, compassion, regret, and advice rather than simply revisiting an earlier period.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Observing, speaking to, protecting, judging, or being ignored by the younger self at different ages.

topNewOpportunities.title: End of the World
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Collective collapse, survival, responsibility for others, unfinished priorities, and aftermath differ substantially from individual death imagery.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Disaster type, companions, escape, acceptance, rebuilding, warning imagery, and non-predictive spiritual framing.

topNewOpportunities.title: Being in Another World
topNewOpportunities.distinct: An altered reality with unfamiliar rules, bodies, societies, or routes home is broader than being in an unfamiliar real-world location.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Belonging, exploration, threat, return, changed identity, alternate rules, and comparison with waking life.

topNewOpportunities.title: Being Someone Else
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Inhabiting another identity, role, body, age, or viewpoint differs from seeing a figure change form.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Known versus unknown identity, voluntary versus forced change, retained memory, role reversal, and return to self.

topNewOpportunities.title: River
topNewOpportunities.distinct: A broader river page can address entering, following, crossing, resisting, or being carried by a current; the existing page is limited to observation.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Banks, current, depth, clarity, flooding, crossing method, destination, and companions.

topNewOpportunities.title: Crossing a Bridge
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Deliberate passage, hesitation, bridge condition, and destination form a different interpretive act from jumping off.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Safe, broken, narrow, moving, unfinished, crowded, high, and return-crossing scenarios.

topNewOpportunities.title: Wearing a Mask
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Concealment, performance, protection, recognition, and removing a chosen covering differ from bodily transformation.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Voluntary or forced masks, disguise, removal, damaged masks, social settings, and being recognized.

topNewOpportunities.title: Floating
topNewOpportunities.distinct: General weightlessness or drifting can occur over land, water, rooms, or crowds and need not involve flight or a dark void.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Control, tethering, height, direction, landing, drifting away, bodily sensation, and emotional tone.

topNewOpportunities.title: Being Judged
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Informal social, family, work, religious, or self-judgment is broader than a formal courtroom scene.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Known versus unknown judges, public verdicts, silent scrutiny, fairness, evidence, and self-criticism.

topNewOpportunities.title: Cow
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Farm, herd, calf, feeding, milking, blocking, charging, and caregiving contexts create a distinct animal topic.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Herd behavior, temperament, condition, ownership, nourishment, labor, vulnerability, and sourced cultural meanings.

topNewOpportunities.title: Being Admired
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Positive attention, validation, attraction, discomfort with praise, and the identity of the admirer differ from scrutiny or surveillance.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Public praise, private admiration, unwanted attention, false praise, achievement, appearance, and recognition.

topNewOpportunities.title: Big House
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Scale itself changes the experience through unused rooms, responsibility, status, possibility, awe, emptiness, or isolation.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Ownership, exploration, maintenance, hidden areas, guests, getting lost, inherited space, and unfinished rooms.

topNewOpportunities.title: Coming Back to Life
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Revival centers reversal, second chances, changed priorities, disbelief, and the relationship between an ending and renewed agency.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Self versus another person reviving, relief versus fear, incomplete return, changed identity, and aftermath.

topNewOpportunities.title: Shadow Figure
topNewOpportunities.distinct: A visually indistinct humanlike presence has unique questions of distance, motion, identity, recognition, and ambiguity.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Doorway, bedside, following, silent, familiar, protective, and threatening contexts without asserting a supernatural cause.

topNewOpportunities.title: Starting a New Job
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Entry into a new role focuses readiness, belonging, competence, first impressions, and unfamiliar expectations rather than ongoing work pressure.
topNewOpportunities.potential: First day, lateness, wrong role, missing tools, former workplace, welcoming or hostile colleagues, and sudden promotion.

topNewOpportunities.title: Changing Clothes
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Changing presentation or role—voluntarily or under pressure—is distinct from clothing being destroyed by fire.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Privacy, fit, occasion, repeated changes, uniforms, old versus new clothing, interruption, and identity presentation.

topNewOpportunities.title: Hugging Someone
topNewOpportunities.distinct: The reciprocal physical action introduces acceptance, refusal, comfort, reconciliation, farewell, boundaries, and bodily response.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Familiar, estranged, deceased, unknown, reluctant, prolonged, interrupted, and goodbye embraces.

topNewOpportunities.title: Drought
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Absence of water, waiting for rain, failed growth, conservation, and environmental exposure differ from food scarcity.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Dry land, empty wells, threatened crops, searching for water, first rain, shared resources, and recovery.

topNewOpportunities.title: Sunrise
topNewOpportunities.distinct: A sunrise is a timed transition from night into day, carrying questions of beginning, waiting, visibility, and what follows darkness.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Watching alone or with others, missed sunrise, unusual colors, delayed dawn, travel toward it, and emotional response.

topNewOpportunities.title: Watching a Sunset
topNewOpportunities.distinct: A sunset centers closure, time passing, beauty, reluctance, and transition into uncertainty rather than unexplained light.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Companions, location, colors, interrupted view, rapid sunset, journey ending, peace, and grief.

topNewOpportunities.title: Smoke
topNewOpportunities.distinct: Smoke can obscure a cause, limit visibility, signal danger, or linger after an event even when flames are absent.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Color, density, source, breathing difficulty, warning others, clearing smoke, smell, and aftermath.

topNewOpportunities.title: Breaking Chains
topNewOpportunities.distinct: The specific act of breaking restraint centers agency, effort, liberation, helping another, failure, and what remains afterward.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Self-release, freeing others, weak or unbreakable chains, repeated restraint, tools, injury, pursuit, and chosen bonds.

topNewOpportunities.title: Meeting Someone Famous
topNewOpportunities.distinct: An encounter can explore recognition, idealization, influence, access, status, disappointment, and comparison without a romance or marriage premise.
topNewOpportunities.potential: Admired versus disliked figures, being ignored or recognized, conversation, advice, embarrassment, and role reversal.
